The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#717; borg-reborn-rs #1065, PR #1089; the request's latest re-pin). Two arms at c7e55e1d: ctl (shipped: the #926 bundle on, fast_fragile_heal_min_ratio 30) and ratio0 (fast_fragile_heal_min_ratio 0, the play of track-p before #1065). Pilot as the gate, then the full tier (classes-1800 starts 901-1800, 900 per arm). Fast-fragile decisions are rare (about 1 game in 60, #660, #596) and this gate is rarer still; the requester's local replays of 7 seeds play identical keys with ratio 30 and ratio 0, the gate never reached, so the pilot may show no difference, which is a result too.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, specimen c7e55e1d. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays (ratio0 against ctl: a gate that never fires plays the same keys). Report: paired deaths ctl against ratio0 with the rescued and the newly killed games (exact McNemar), CL and depth, alive at the cap having reached DL5; per arm the counts of the two '(#1065)' trace notes ('# Fast-fragile in contact, HP a/b: at the heal floor, a cure is allowed if it leaves ...' and '... even a full heal leaves ... no cure at the heal floor') and the games they occur in (pilot, retained evidence); deaths to fast-fragile monsters (crow, wild cat) and deaths with a cure potion in the pack. Whether 30 stays shipped is a borg-reborn-rs decision on this run. Descriptive (RULES 14).
